skill.name: azure-compute
skill.description: Guides Azure VM and VM Scale Set recommendation, pricing, creation, troubleshooting, capacity reservations, and Essential Machine Management workflows.
skill.summary: Route Azure compute requests to focused VM, VMSS, pricing, deployment, and troubleshooting workflows.
skill.author: microsoft

security_audit.summary: Static analysis flagged many command, URL, filesystem, and SSH references. Most are benign documentation, markdown links, Azure or Microsoft endpoints, private network examples, or SSH public key handling. A small set of troubleshooting commands can change guest security posture and should keep explicit confirmation and rollback guidance.

remediation.issue: Guest security changes in troubleshooting commands
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before commands that open firewall rules, unlock accounts, or set SELinux permissive. Show rollback commands when possible.
Ask before using third-party IP detection, prefer an Azure-supported source when available, and let users provide a CIDR manually.

remediation.issue: SSH public key access outside the workspace
remediation.suggestion: Ask before reading SSH public key files from a home directory. Never read, request, or store private key files.

content.value_statement: Azure compute work involves many VM, VMSS, pricing, and troubleshooting decisions. This skill routes each request to focused Azure workflows and produces clear deployment or repair guidance.
actual_capabilities: Routes VM, VMSS, capacity reservation, troubleshooting, and EMM requests to focused workflows.
Compares Azure VM families, VMSS options, prices, quota checks, and regional availability.
Generates Azure CLI, Bicep, Terraform, or Azure MCP deployment plans for bare compute.
Guides RDP, SSH, NSG, firewall, credential, and VM agent troubleshooting.
Explains Capacity Reservation Group creation, association, disassociation, billing, and validation.
Guides Essential Machine Management enrollment, prerequisites, permissions, and troubleshooting.
limitations: It depends on current Azure documentation and live checks for final availability and pricing.
It does not replace tenant policy, change approval, or production architecture review.
Some actions require Azure credentials, permissions, and explicit user approval.
It focuses on compute infrastructure, not full application deployment.

use_cases.title: Create a VM Deployment Plan
use_cases.description: Build a validated plan for a Linux or Windows VM with cost, quota, networking, and output format decisions.

use_cases.title: Compare VM Cost Options
use_cases.description: Compare VM families, VMSS choices, pay-as-you-go prices, reservations, and capacity constraints for a workload.

use_cases.title: Troubleshoot RDP or SSH Access
use_cases.description: Follow a structured path for VM state, network rules, guest firewall, credentials, and safe recovery steps.

prompt_templates.title: Recommend a VM
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend an Azure VM for a small Linux web server in eastus. Prioritize low cost and explain the trade-offs.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Deployment Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Bicep deployment plan for a secure Ubuntu VM. Use SSH from my public IP only and include a cost estimate.

prompt_templates.title: Troubleshoot Connectivity
prompt_templates.prompt: My Azure VM will not accept SSH connections. Guide me through read-only checks first, then safe recovery options.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Capacity and Management
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a VMSS with capacity reservation and Essential Machine Management for a production workload. Include validation, risks, and approval points.

output_examples.input: I need a small Linux VM for development in eastus.
output_examples.output: A plan card with recommended size, region, image, SSH source, cost estimate, quota status, and delivery choices.

output_examples.input: My Windows VM shows a black screen when I use RDP.
output_examples.output: A troubleshooting sequence that checks VM state, RDP symptoms, NSG rules, guest service status, and approval-based recovery options.

output_examples.input: Reserve capacity for GPU VMs before a launch.
output_examples.output: A capacity reservation plan with region, SKU, quantity, billing warning, validation steps, and association guidance.

best_practices: Run read-only validation before changing Azure resources.
Use least-privilege source IP ranges for SSH and RDP.
Review generated plans and cost estimates before applying changes.
anti_patterns: Do not open SSH or RDP to all internet addresses without documented approval.
Do not run guest Run Command repairs before VM agent and extension checks pass.
Do not use this skill for full application deployment when a platform workflow fits better.

faq.question: Can this skill create Azure resources directly?
faq.answer: It can guide Azure MCP apply flows when available, but live changes require explicit user approval.

faq.question: Does it support both VM and VMSS scenarios?
faq.answer: Yes. It routes single VM, VMSS, autoscale, and capacity reservation requests to separate workflows.

faq.question: Can it estimate Azure VM pricing?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses Azure retail pricing guidance and should verify current prices when live access is available.

faq.question: Does it handle production security design?
faq.answer: It provides compute security prompts and warnings, but production designs still need organizational review.

faq.question: Can it troubleshoot failed SSH or RDP connections?
faq.answer: Yes. It starts with read-only evidence and then presents guarded repair options.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
